{{tl|nsv}} is the inverse of {{tl|ns}}—it takes a namespace and returns the corresponding version.

== Usage ==

<pre><nowiki>{{nsv|1|release=|title=}}</nowiki></pre>

=== Parameters ===

* <code>1</code> — Namespace (<code>DF2014</code>, <code>v0.34</code>, <code>DF2012</code>, <code>v0.31</code>, <code>DF2010</code>, <code>40d</code>, <code>23a</code>). Putting a nonexistent namespace in the first parameter or leaving it in blank will result in this error message: {{nsv|}}. If the parameter is not included at all, it returns the most recent version of the game instead.
* <code>title</code> — Displays a leading "v" or "DF&nbsp;" in front of the version number. Case insensitive.
** "v" — Accepts <code>version</code>, <code>ver</code>, or <code>v</code>.
** "DF&nbsp;" — Accepts <code>dwarf fortress</code>, <code>dwarffortress</code>, or <code>df</code>.

=== Examples ===

<pre>
* {{nsv|DF2012}}
* {{nsv|v0.31}}
* {{nsv|40d|title=Dwarf Fortress}}
* {{nsv|23a|title=v}}
* {{nsv}} (equivalent to {{Current/version}})
</pre>

* {{nsv|DF2012}}
* {{nsv|v0.31|r=9}}
* {{nsv|40d|title=Dwarf Fortress}}
* {{nsv|23a|title=v}}
* {{nsv}} (equivalent to {{Current/version}})
